args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Use Pellow Home Living (PHL) going forward.
- Moss's coverage digest still shows a saved report titled "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living.
- Please check whether any other saved reports, digests or dashboards still use the Covey & Lark name, and update them.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. Please don't mix the two up when cleaning up labels.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll
